question: Each vowel in the word LOCKER is changed to the letter preceding it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter following it in the English alphabetical order. Which of the following letters will appear twice in the group of letters thus formed?
solution:
Given:

Each vowel in the word LOCKER is changed to the letter preceding it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter following it in the English alphabetical order.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43c57fbadaa1a33d1e3a424bd6403b477d4771ba7082b2d5a001cf5bc32a47cf.png] 

So, letter **D** will appear twice in the group of letters thus formed.

Hence, the correct answer is** "D".**
